sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 17.08.2022, registered as Case Crime No.162 of 2022, under Sections-498A, 323, 504, 506, 313, 377, 376, 511 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Rail Bazar, District-Kanpur Nagar and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
Javed And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14424271/
1
3. The matter was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court on 10.11.2022, but the same has failed.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that it is a matrimonial dispute.
5. It is not clear that whether the charge-sheet has been submitted or not in this case.

6. In view of the above, petition is disposed of directing that till cognizance is taken on police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C., by the court the respondents shall not arrest the petitioners pursuant to theFirst Information Report dated17.08.2022, registered as Case Crime No.162 of 2022, under Sections-498A, 323, 504, 506, 313, 377, 376, 511 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Rail Bazar, District-Kanpur Nagar, subject to cooperation in ongoing investigation.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Amit (Surendra Singh-I,J.) (Siddharth,J.)
